name: R4-G9
description: R4-G9 was a feminine astromech droid with white plating, bronze outlines, and a green sensor. She was assigned to Jedi Aayla Secura and later Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi right at the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY. She served as the replacement to Kenobi's previous droid R4-P17 for she had been destroyed by buzz droids while assisting her master in the Battle of Coruscant.
